premise.claim: KEP-531 motivation: "Referencing a profile injects wherever the pattern happens to; a role cannot say 'this runtime belongs to the worker component.'" / "No way to touch role-declared containers. A profile author cannot add an env var or a volumeMount to the role's own engine container." / "Role customization of profile containers is env/args-only." (issue #531 inventory)
premise.reportedComponent: RoleBasedGroup → workload render pipeline (sidecar_builder legacy engine-runtime injection)
premise.patchedComponent: same: pkg/discovery render pipeline, v1alpha1/v1alpha2 API + CRDs, webhooks, CERP controller
premise.evidence: Base (ea5e82ae) pkg/discovery/sidecar_builder.go injectRuntime: the legacy containers override merges env/args only and ignores every other corev1.Container field; profileName is the sole targeting knob; results/base-differential-sidecar.out pins base injecting unconditionally whatever the role's pattern (differential for F2).
